result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: annual frequency, 30 days’ written notice, business-hours timing, an independent confidentiality-bound auditor, Vendor-paid costs subject to the existing 5% threshold, and no direct or remote system access. It preserves Vendor’s ability to verify usage. However, the added non-disruption requirement goes beyond the stated playbook position, so the revision is not strictly minimal. The margin comment’s reference to an “off-site” audit is also broader than the operative clause and the playbook, though it does not undermine compliance.
